title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, August 25 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Supramax values firmed this week following evidence of more strong pricing, as seen in the sales of the Gramos and Global Oriole. Kamsarmax BBG Wuzhou (81,900 DWT, 2016, Tsuneishi Zhoushan) sold Auction, SS/DD Due to Indian buyers for USD 29 mil, VV Value USD 30.8 mil. Ultramax Gramos (61,000 DWT, 2019, Nantong COSCO KHI) sold to Greek buyers for USD 34.5 mil, VV Value USD 33.3 mil.
